name: @gino/e2ee
description: Gino end-to-end encryption for TypeScript — the gino-e2ee crate compiled to wasm (envelopes, history, field maps, MLS scope groups, client helpers) and the host-side key directory and Delivery Service (`@gino/e2ee/ds`).

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --target browser --format esm && bun build src/ds/index.ts src/ds/testing.ts --outdir dist/ds --target node --format esm --external @gino/e2ee --external zod && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
scripts.check: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build
